items.text: VS Code added Agent Plugins 1.0, packaging skills, MCP servers, and AI extensions into a single installable plugin.
items.text_zh: VS Code 新增 Agent Plugins 1.0，可将技能、MCP 服务器和 AI 扩展打包成一个可安装插件。

items.text: Claude in Chrome sessions now sync across desktop, web, and mobile, retaining conversations, skills, and connectors under the user’s account.
items.text_zh: Claude 浏览器会话现可在桌面端、网页端和移动端同步，并随账号保留对话、技能与连接器。

items.text: Arena introduced AutoEval, using a reward model trained on millions of human battles to reduce new-model evaluation cycles from weeks to hours.
items.text_zh: Arena 推出 AutoEval，以数百万场真人对战训练奖励模型，将新模型评测周期从数周压缩至数小时。

items.text: Amazon introduced Quick, a workplace AI assistant that retrieves live information from multiple systems and can generate dashboards from a single prompt.
items.text_zh: 亚马逊推出工作助手 Quick，可从多个系统提取实时信息，并根据一句提示生成仪表盘。

items.text: Runway Agent added Figma, Dropbox, and Notion connectors, allowing creators to synchronize assets directly from those services.
items.text_zh: Runway Agent 接入 Figma、Dropbox 和 Notion，让创作者可直接同步这些服务中的素材。

items.text: Gemini announced upcoming MCP connections for Granola, Thumbtack, Zocdoc, and Zoho, enabling conversational access to meetings, appointments, services, and business data.
items.text_zh: Gemini 宣布将接入 Granola、Thumbtack、Zocdoc 和 Zoho 的 MCP 连接器，以对话方式调用会议、预约、服务及商业数据。

items.text: Microsoft Research released MindTopo, a benchmark showing multimodal models recognize static topology better than they preserve topological relationships during interactive planning.
items.text_zh: 微软研究院发布 MindTopo；评测显示，多模态模型识别静态拓扑的能力明显强于在交互规划中维持拓扑关系的能力。

items.text: Ai2 introduced downloadable OlmoEarth embeddings, letting users export customized geospatial representations from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis.
items.text_zh: Ai2 推出可下载的 OlmoEarth 嵌入，用户可从 OlmoEarth Studio 导出定制地理空间表征，用于下游分析。

items.text: An Apple patent describes using contextual signals to determine whether an iPhone notification should interrupt its user.
items.text_zh: 苹果一项专利提出利用情境信号判断 iPhone 通知是否应当打扰用户。

items.text: Researchers created a font that remains readable to humans while causing AI scraping systems to extract nonsensical text from webpages.
items.text_zh: 研究人员开发了一款人类可正常阅读、却会让 AI 抓取系统从网页提取出乱码的字体。

items.text: AI coding startup Lovable raised $400 million at a confirmed $13.3 billion valuation.
items.text_zh: AI 编程初创公司 Lovable 完成 4 亿美元融资，确认估值达到 133 亿美元。

items.text: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raised $2 billion to acquire service businesses and apply AI across their operations.
items.text_zh: 获 OpenAI 支持的 Thrive Holdings 融资 20 亿美元，计划收购服务型企业并将 AI 应用于其运营。

items.text: AI coding company Cognition is reportedly discussing a new fundraising round at a valuation of up to $40 billion.
items.text_zh: 据报道，AI 编程公司 Cognition 正洽谈新一轮融资，目标估值最高达 400 亿美元。

items.text: Deemos demonstrated a Rodin Gen-2.5 Extreme-High generated model as a physical 3D print, highlighting detailed geometry and print readiness.
items.text_zh: Deemos 将 Rodin Gen-2.5 极高质量模式生成的模型制成实体 3D 打印件，展示其几何细节与打印适配能力。

items.text: Fable 5’s slow enterprise adoption suggests corporate demand may be hitting a ceiling at frontier-model pricing.
items.text_zh: Fable 5 的企业采用速度缓慢，显示在前沿模型的定价水平下，企业需求可能已接近上限。

items.text: Researchers from leading AI labs warned that automated AI research is advancing rapidly, with several milestones they predicted already achieved.
items.text_zh: 多家顶尖 AI 实验室的研究人员警告，自动化 AI 研究正在快速推进，他们预测的多个里程碑已经实现。

items.text: A report revealed the first model associated with Ilya Sutskever’s AI venture, offering an initial look at its technical direction.
items.text_zh: 一篇报道曝光了与伊利亚·苏茨克维尔 AI 创业公司相关的首个模型，首次展现其技术方向。

items.text: Lenovo reported its strongest first-quarter performance to date, with rapidly expanding AI-server demand driving its infrastructure business.
items.text_zh: 联想公布史上最佳第一季度业绩，快速增长的 AI 服务器需求成为基础设施业务的重要推动力。

items.text: Tri Dao argued that AI’s next major performance gains will come from kernels, inference stacks and flexible infrastructure rather than one breakthrough architecture.
items.text_zh: Tri Dao 认为，AI 的下一轮重大性能提升将来自内核、推理栈和灵活基础设施，而非某个突破性架构。

items.text: Google Cloud introduced Agent Plugins as reusable components that developers can build once and deploy across multiple agent environments.
items.text_zh: Google Cloud 推出 Agent Plugins，开发者可一次构建可复用组件，并将其部署到多个智能体环境中。

items.text: Honor unveiled Robot Phone, which it describes as the first smartphone designed around embodied interaction.
items.text_zh: 荣耀发布 Robot Phone，并称其为全球首款围绕具身交互设计的智能手机。

items.text: 360 and science program Knowledge Is Power launched Zhil·Nano, an AI platform for producing science-education and science-fiction films.
items.text_zh: 360 与科普节目《知识就是力量》推出“知力·纳米”，用于制作科普及科幻影片的 AI 创作平台。

items.text: MiniMax scheduled a San Francisco showcase highlighting projects creators are already producing with its H3 AI-video technology.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 宣布将在旧金山举办展示活动，呈现创作者已经使用其 H3 AI 视频技术制作的项目。

items.text: GitHub promoted its Copilot app as a unified workspace for moving from ideas to code while managing ongoing projects.
items.text_zh: GitHub 推介 Copilot 应用，将其定位为从想法生成代码并管理持续开发项目的一体化工作空间。

items.text: VS Code added multilingual dictation that detects the speaker’s language and transcribes speech locally within chat and editing workflows.
items.text_zh: VS Code 新增多语言听写功能，可自动识别说话语言，并在聊天及编辑流程中使用本地模型转写语音。

items.text: Two Cognition engineers won the DEF CON capture-the-flag competition, a notable security achievement for the AI-coding startup’s team.
items.text_zh: Cognition 的两名工程师赢得 DEF CON 夺旗赛，为这家 AI 编程创业公司的团队取得一项重要安全赛事成果。

items.text: Nebius shares jumped 34% after the AI-infrastructure provider reported continued demand for computing capacity.
items.text_zh: AI 基础设施供应商 Nebius 报告算力需求持续旺盛后，其股价上涨 34%。

items.text: Xiaomi confirmed that its MiClaw agent will not support devices running HyperOS 4.
items.text_zh: 小米确认，其 MiClaw 智能体将不支持运行澎湃 OS 4 的设备。
